name: Invoke the Hungering Void
body:
Minimum Spell Level: 5th.

You can cast deeper darkness as a full-round action. The darkness also counts as a bat swarm. Creatures within the darkness are dealt swarm damage (1d6 plus bleed 1) at the start of your turn.
